arxiv-2102-08981.title: Conceptual 12M: Pushing Web-Scale Image-Text Pre-Training To Recognize Long-Tail Visual Concepts
arxiv-2102-08981.creator: Soravit Changpinyo, Piyush Sharma, Nan Ding, Radu Soricut Google Research schangpi,piyushsharma,dingnan,rsoricut@google.com
arxiv-2102-08981.description: Abstract The availability of large-scale image captioning and visual question answering datasets has contributed significantly to recent successes in vision-and-language pre-training. However, these datasets are often collected with overrestrictive requirements inherited from their original target tasks (e.g., image caption generation), which limit the resulting dataset scale and diversity.

arxiv-2109-03657.title: Geometric properties of some generalized Mathieu power series inside the unit disk Thanks: Živorad Tomovski was supported by DAAD, during his visit to the Department of Physics at the University of Potsdam in Germany from 15 June 2021 to 15 September 2021 to collaborate with Ralf Metzler.
arxiv-2109-03657.creator: Stefan Gerhold, Živorad Tomovski, Deepak Bansal and Amit Soni
arxiv-2109-03657.description:
A 2021 arXiv research paper by Stefan Gerhold, Živorad Tomovski, Deepak Bansal and Amit Soni. We consider two parametric families of special functions: One is defined by a power series generalizing the classical Mathieu series, and the other one is a generalized Mathieu type power series involving factorials in its coefficients. Using criteria due to Fejér and Ozaki, we provide sufficient conditions for these functions to be close-to-convex or starlike inside the unit disk, and thus univalent. 2010 Mathematics Subject Classification
33E20, 40A10, 30C45

1.

arxiv-2111-04938.title: Kernel Estimation of Bivariate Time-varying Coefficient Model for Longitudinal Data With Terminal Event
arxiv-2111-04938.creator: Yue Wang, Bin Nan
arxiv-2111-04938.description: Abstract We propose a nonparametric bivariate time-varying coefficient model for longitudinal measurements with the occurrence of a terminal event that is subject to right censoring. The time-varying coefficients capture the longitudinal trajectories of covariate effects along with both the followup time and the residual lifetime.

arxiv-2203-16311.title: When to Go, and When to Explore: The Benefit of Post-Exploration in Intrinsic Motivation
arxiv-2203-16311.creator: Zhao Yang, Thomas M. Moerland, Mike Preuss, Aske Plaat
arxiv-2203-16311.description: Abstract Go-Explore achieved breakthrough performance on challenging reinforcement learning (RL) tasks with sparse rewards. The key insight of Go-Explore was that successful exploration requires an agent to first return to an interesting state (‘Go’), and only then explore into unknown terrain (‘Explore’). We refer to such exploration after a goal is reached as ‘post-exploration’.

arxiv-2207-02668.title: VI-SLAM2tag: Low-Effort Labeled Dataset Collection for Fingerprinting-Based Indoor Localization Thanks: The dataset can be found at DOI:10.5281/zenodo.6801310. The implementations are hosted at https://github.com/laskama.
arxiv-2207-02668.creator: Marius Laska, Till Schulz, Jan Grottke, Christoph Blut, Jörg Blankenbach
arxiv-2207-02668.description: Abstract Fingerprinting-based approaches are particularly suitable for deploying indoor positioning systems for pedestrians with minimal infrastructure costs. The accuracy of the method, however, strongly depends on the quality of collected labeled fingerprints within the calibration phase, which is a tedious process when done manually in a static fashion.

arxiv-2210-13349.title: Ultrahigh-energy cosmic-ray signature in GRB 221009A
arxiv-2210-13349.creator: Saikat Das, Soebur Razzaque
arxiv-2210-13349.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Saikat Das, Soebur Razzaque. The brightest long gamma-ray burst detected so far by the Swift-BAT and Fermi-GBM telescopes, GRB 221009A, provides an unprecedented opportunity for understanding the high-energy processes in extreme transient phenomena. We find that the conventional leptonic models, synchrotron and synchrotron-self-Compton, for the afterglow emission from this source have difficulties explaining the observation of ≳ 10 \gtrsim 10 TeV γ \gamma rays, by the LHAASO detector, and extending up to 18 TeV energies.

arxiv-2302-01984.title: PSST! Prosodic Speech Segmentation with Transformers
arxiv-2302-01984.creator: Nathan Roll 1 , Calbert Graham 2 , Simon Todd 1, \IEEEauthorblockN Nathan Roll \IEEEauthorblockA University of California, Santa Barbara nroll@ucsb.edu, \IEEEauthorblockN Calbert Graham \IEEEauthorblockA University of Cambridge crg29@cam.ac.uk, \IEEEauthorblockN Simon Todd \IEEEauthorblockA Universi
arxiv-2302-01984.description: Abstract Self-attention mechanisms have enabled transformers to achieve superhuman-level performance on many speech-to-text (STT) tasks, yet the challenge of automatic prosodic segmentation has remained unsolved. In this paper we finetune Whisper, a pretrained STT model, to annotate intonation unit (IU) boundaries by repurposing low-frequency tokens. Our approach achieves an accuracy of 95.

arxiv-2303-10055.title: Accreting white dwarfs
arxiv-2303-10055.creator: Natalie Webb
arxiv-2303-10055.description: Abstract White dwarfs are the most common endpoints of stellar evolution. They are often found in close binary systems in which the white dwarf is accreting matter from a companion star, either via an accretion disc or channelled along the white dwarf magnetic field lines.

arxiv-2307-10028.title: Organized crime behavior of shell-company networks in procurement: prevention insights for policy and reform
arxiv-2307-10028.creator: J. R. Nicolás-Carlock, I. Luna-Pla ∗
arxiv-2307-10028.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by J. R. Nicolás-Carlock, I. Luna-Pla ∗. In recent years, the analysis of economic crime and corruption in procurement has benefited from integrative studies that acknowledge the interconnected nature of the procurement ecosystem. Following this line of research, we present a networks approach for the analysis of shell-companies operations in procurement that makes use of contracting and ownership data under one framework to gain knowledge about the organized crime behavior that emerges in this setting.

arxiv-2310-15625.title: The First Light Curve Analysis of Twin Binary System V1175 Cas using Ground-based and TESS data Journal: New Astronomy
arxiv-2310-15625.creator: Neslihan Alan
arxiv-2310-15625.description: Abstract Eclipsing binary systems hold a central position within astrophysics in that the fundamental parameters of stars can be determined by direct observations. The simultaneous analyses of high-quality space observations, combined with ground-based photometric data, have allowed more sensitive detection of fundamental stellar parameters by multicolor photometry.

arxiv-2406-16679.title: Multi-Robot Collaborative Localization and Planning with Inter-Ranging
arxiv-2406-16679.creator: Derek Knowles, Adam Dai, Grace Gao
arxiv-2406-16679.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Derek Knowles, Adam Dai, Grace Gao. Robots often use feature-based image tracking to identify their position in their surrounding environment; however, feature-based image tracking is prone to errors in low-textured and poorly lit environments. Specifically, we investigate a scenario where robots are tasked with exploring the surface of the Moon and are required to have an accurate estimate of their position to be able to correctly geotag scientific measurements.

arxiv-2601-13853.title: Basic Albanese maps of regular Riemannian foliations
arxiv-2601-13853.creator: Kinga Słowik 1,2, Robert Wolak 1
arxiv-2601-13853.description: Abstract . In the paper we introduce the notion of basic Albanese map which we define for foliated Riemannian manifolds using basic 1-forms. We relate this mapping to the classical Albanese map for the ambient manifold. The study of general properties is supplemented with the description of several important examples. 1991 Mathematics Subject Classification 53C12 1.

arxiv-2602-10990.title: Cutoff Sobolev inequalities for local and non-local p p -energies on metric measure spaces
arxiv-2602-10990.creator: Meng Yang
arxiv-2602-10990.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by Meng Yang. For p > 1 p>1 , we study subordination phenomena for local and non-local regular p p -energies on metric measure spaces. Under suitable geometric assumptions, we show that if a local regular p p -energy satisfies a Poincaré inequality together with a cutoff Sobolev inequality with scaling function Ψ \Psi , then all associated stable-like non-local p p -energies with scaling functions strictly below Ψ \Psi are regular and satisfy the corresponding non-local cutoff Sobolev inequalities.

arxiv-2602-13681.title: An Ensemble Learning Approach towards Waste Segmentation in Cluttered Environment
arxiv-2602-13681.creator: Maimoona Jafar, Ahsan Saadat, Syed Imran Ali, Shah Khalid, Muhammad Bilal
arxiv-2602-13681.description: Abstract Environmental pollution is a critical global issue, with recycling emerging as one of the most viable solutions. This study focuses on waste segregation, a crucial step in recycling processes to obtain raw material. Recent advancements in computer vision have significantly contributed to waste classification and recognition.

arxiv-2605-10889.title: Unmasking On-Policy Distillation: Where It Helps, Where It Hurts, and Why
arxiv-2605-10889.creator: Mohammadreza Armandpour, Fatih Ilhan, David Harrison, Ajay Jaiswal, Duc N.M Hoang, Fartash Faghri, Yizhe Zhang, Minsik Cho, Mehrdad Farajtabar

The neutron resonance parameters for <sup>19</sup>F were evaluated using transmission, capture, and inelastic data in the resonance region from thermal energies up to 1 MeV. The analyses were carried out with the code SAMMY. A key feature of this evaluation is the inclusion of a

plos-pone-0001633.creator: Stephen E. Malawista, Anne de Boisfleury Chevance
plos-pone-0001633.description: PLOS ONE research article. In order to clear the body of infecting spirochetes, phagocytic cells must be able to get hold of them. In real-time phase-contrast videomicroscopy we were able to measure the speed of Borrelia burgdorferi (Bb), the Lyme spirochete, moving back and forth across a platelet to whic

pmc-10499935.title: Prefrontal hypoactivation induced via social stress is more strongly associated with state rumination than depressive symptomatology
pmc-10499935.creator: Isabell Int-Veen, Andreas J Fallgatter, Ann-Christine Ehlis, David Rosenbaum
pmc-10499935.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Previous studies have consistently shown a pattern of prefrontal hypoactivation in depressed patients (DP); however, it remains unclear whether this neural correlate is a consequence or concomitant feature of depression and/or whether ruminative thinking might be underlying. Using a sample comprising 65 healthy controls (HC) and 77 DP, we investigated the behavioral and neural correlates in response to stress and their association with depressive symptomatology, trait and state rumination.

pmc-10694057.title: A dataset of physico-chemical properties, extractable organic N, N mineralization and physical organic matter fractionation of soils developed on loess silts, crystalline rocks and sedimentary rocks
pmc-10694057.creator: Thierry Morvan, Yvon Lambert, Philippe Germain, Blandine Lemercier, Mariana Moreira, Laure Beff
pmc-10694057.description: A network of 137 cultivated fields covering the wide diversity of soils, crop rotations and cropping practices throughout the region of Brittany (France) was monitored to collect data on soil organic nitrogen (SON) mineralization and to identify the factors that explain the observed variability.

pmc-11476630.title: Iron Metabolism in Aminolevulinic Acid-Photodynamic Therapy with Iron Chelators from the Thiosemicarbazone Group
pmc-11476630.creator: Robert Gawecki, Patrycja Rawicka, Marta Rogalska, Maciej Serda, Anna Mrozek-Wilczkiewicz
pmc-11476630.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Iron plays a crucial role in various metabolic processes. However, the impact of 5-aminolevulinic acid (ALA) in combination with iron chelators on iron metabolism and the efficacy of ALA-photodynamic therapy (PDT) remain inadequately understood. This study aimed to examine the effect of thiosemicarbazone derivatives during ALA treatment on specific genes related to iron metabolism, with a particular emphasis on mitochondrial iron metabolism genes. In our study, we observed differences depending on the cell line studied.

pmc-11638375.title: Protoporphyrin IX iron(II) revisited. An overview of the Mössbauer spectroscopic parameters of low-spin porphyrin iron(II) complexes
pmc-11638375.creator: Jack Silver, Daniel den Engelsen, Golzar al-Jaff, Jehad A Taies, Michael T Wilson, George R Fern
pmc-11638375.description: Mössbauer parameters of low-spin six-coordinate [Fe(II)(Por)L2] complexes (where Por is a synthetic porphyrin; L is a nitrogenous aliphatic, an aromatic base or a heterocyclic ligand, a P-bonding ligand, CO or CN) and low-spin [Fe(Por)LX] complexes (where L and X are different ligands) are reported.

pmc-12400070.title: The Impact of Waitlisting After a Weekend on Transplant‐Related Outcomes for Patients With Acute Liver Failure in the US
pmc-12400070.creator: Melis G. Celdir, Qianyi Shi, Tomohiro Tanaka
pmc-12400070.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). IntroductionPotential delays in patient care during weekends have not been studied in liver transplantation (LT) for acute liver failure (ALF). We evaluated the impact of listing after a weekend on waitlist (WL) and post‐LT outcomes in ALF patients.MethodsIn a retrospective cohort study of adult ALF patients from February 2002 to May 2023 in the United Network for Organ Sharing (UNOS) database, the primary exposure was listing after a weekend.

pmc-12790481.title: Endoscopic Deflux Injection for Vesicoureteral Reflux in a Renal Allograft Complicated by Recurrent Acute Pyelonephritis: A Case Report
pmc-12790481.creator: Tomohiro Matsuo, Tsuyoshi Matsuda, Kensuke Mitsunari, Kojiro Ohba, Ryoichi Imamura
pmc-12790481.description: Vesicoureteral reflux (VUR) in a renal allograft ureter is a well-recognized and clinically significant complication that may lead to recurrent febrile urinary tract infection (fUTI) and progressive allograft dysfunction. While open ureteral reimplantation remains a standard surgical option, it is relatively invasive for kidney transplant recipients.

pmc-12997147.title: The mediating role of nutritional indicators in the association between estimated glomerular filtration rate and cognitive impairment in older adults
pmc-12997147.creator: Xiuping An, Yao Cui, Mingzhao Qin, Jian Zhou, Qian Liu, Hui Ye
pmc-12997147.description: BackgroundCognitive impairment (CI) is common in older adults, especially those with renal dysfunction. We aimed to investigate the complex relationships among renal function, nutritional status, and CI in older people free from late chronic kidney disease (CKD) and severe CI.MethodsA study of older people (≥60 years old) with an estimated glomerular filtration rate (eGFR) of >30 mL/min/1.

pmc-13057466.title: Molecular weight fractionated extracellular polymeric substances (EPS) impart different aggregation characteristics on polystyrene nanoplastics
pmc-13057466.creator: Feng-Yi Li, Gui-Yun Song, Qing-Xin Zhang, Mi-Hong Hou
pmc-13057466.description: This study explores how EPS with varying molecular weights (MW) adsorb onto polystyrene nanoplastics coated with bare (PS-Bare), carboxylic (PS-COOH), or amine (PS-NH₂) functional groups. Experiments were performed in NaCl and CaCl2 to characterize the formed eco-corona and their impacts on nanoplastics aggregation kinetics.

pmc-13235521.title: Effectiveness of a blended in-person and online parenting programme in reducing violence against children in rural Thailand: a cluster randomised controlled trial
pmc-13235521.creator: Wilaiwan Pongpaew, Amalee McCoy, Sombat Tapanya, Jamie M Lachman, Frances Gardner, GJ Melendez-Torres, Qing Han, Piya Hanvoravongchai
pmc-13235521.description: SummaryBackgroundViolence against children remains a substantial public health concern in Thailand. We evaluated whether a blended in-person and online messaging-based parenting programme could reduce child maltreatment.MethodsWe conducted a parallel, two-arm, cluster-randomised, assessor-blinded trial in 12 sub-district health-promoting hospitals in Udon Thani, Thailand.

pmc-13308706.title: barbieQ: an R software package for analysing barcode count data from clonal tracking experiments
pmc-13308706.creator: Liyang Fei, Jovana Maksimovic, Alicia Oshlack
pmc-13308706.description: MotivationA ‘clone’ encompasses a progenitor cell and its progeny cells. Tracking clonal composition as cells differentiate or evolve is useful in many fields. Various single-cell lineage tracing (clonal tracking) technologies use unique DNA barcodes that are passed from progenitor cells to their offspring. The barcode count for each sample indicates cell number in clones.

pmc-13331773.title: Cotton-top tamarins (Saguinus oedipus) can serve as definitive hosts of the rodent metastrongyloid parasite Angiostrongylus dujardini and develop fatal infections
pmc-13331773.creator: Seraina L Meister, Christian Wenker, Michael Rüttener, Gastón Moré, Walter Basso

pmc-13474245.creator: John T Stutts, Yong S Choe, Linlin Fan

pmc-13536305.title: Osteoclast-derived exosomes promote medication-related osteonecrosis of the jaw by delivering glycoRNA to disrupt the blood–lymphatic vascular network
pmc-13536305.creator: Jiankang Zhang, Junming Tao, Chengzhi Zhao, Jian Pan
pmc-13536305.description: Background/purposeMedication-related osteonecrosis of the jaw (MRONJ) is a metabolic disorder of the jaw characterized by bone necrosis. Its pathogenesis remains unclear, and elucidating the underlying mechanisms and pathological changes is essential for addressing the clinical challenge of refractory jaw necrosis in MRONJ.

pmc-13621858.title: Location and habitat specificity structure benthic microbial assemblages in a temperate seagrass ecosystem
pmc-13621858.creator: Gabriel A. Serrano, Alejandro De Santiago, Tiago J. Pereira, Mirayana Marcelino Barros, Holly M. Bik
pmc-13621858.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Seagrass meadows are globally distributed coastal ecosystems that provide habitats for diverse species and facilitate ecosystem services, such as carbon storage and nutrient cycling. However, anthropogenic activities and climate change are causing seagrass decline worldwide, broadly impacting ecosystem functioning. Although macrofaunal communities in seagrass habitats are relatively well studied, benthic microbial assemblages (including microeukaryote groups such as protists and microbial metazoa) remain underexplored.

uslaw-usc-t50-s3114.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t50-s3114.description: United States Code, Title 50 (War And National Defense); Chapter 44 (National Security); Subchapter III (Accountability For Intelligence Activities). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) Covered document defined In this section, the term “covered document” means any executive order, memorandum, or policy directive issued by the President, including national security Presidential memoranda and Presidential policy directives, or such successor memoranda and directives.
